pharma.title: Eli Lilly's Orforglipron Tablet gets CDSCO Panel Nod for Import, Marketing in India
pharma.summary: A subject expert committee under the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) recommended approval for importing and marketing Eli Lilly's oral drug Orforglipron in India.

pharma.title: Naprod Seeks Higher NPPA Ceiling Prices for Cisplatin, Carboplatin Amid Cancer Drug Supply Crunch
pharma.summary: Pharmaceutical firm Naprod along with other drug manufacturers requested the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) to revise ceiling prices for key oncology drugs like Cisplatin and Carboplatin to alleviate domestic shortages.

pharma.title: Torrent Pharma Positions for India Launch of MASH Drug Resmetirom
pharma.summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals is preparing to introduce Resmetirom in the Indian market for the treatment of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH).

national.title: Govt to sell up to 3 percent stake in NLC India via OFS
national.summary: The Central Government announced plans to divest up to a 3 percent stake in state-run NLC India Limited through an Offer for Sale (OFS).

national.title: INDIA bloc meeting: Kharge criticises government over SIR, economy, foreign policy
national.summary: Leaders of the INDIA bloc opposition alliance convened to outline a consensus on key administrative concerns, foreign policy challenges, and economic issues.

international.title: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, Democratic Republic of the Congo & Uganda
international.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) issued a surveillance update regarding Ebola disease outbreaks caused by the Bundibugyo virus across parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

international.title: New Delhi says, Indonesia is key pillar of India’s Act East Policy
international.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with his Indonesian counterpart, reiterating that Indonesia remains a pivotal pillar of India's Act East Policy.

international.title: India, China should stick to ‘right strategic perception’ of being cooperative partners: Beijing
international.summary: Beijing stated that India and China should maintain a positive strategic perception and view each other as bilateral cooperative partners rather than threats.

economy.title: India records $7.1 bn current account surplus in Q4 FY26: RBI data
economy.summary: Data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) showed that India recorded a current account surplus of $7.1 billion in the fourth quarter (Q4) of FY26, boosted by strong remittance flows.

economy.title: RBI’s June MPC keeps repo rate unchanged as gulf tensions raise new risks for inflation, growth
economy.summary: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) maintained status quo on key policy rates during its June meeting, keeping the repo rate unchanged amid global geopolitical risks.

economy.title: Goldman Sachs sees rupee weakness capped after RBI's steps to boost inflows
economy.summary: Goldman Sachs reported that proactive liquidity management and capital inflow steps by the Reserve Bank of India are expected to limit further depreciation of the Indian Rupee.

science.title: Aurora Borealis in India? Strong Solar Storm Could Light Up Skies on June 8
science.summary: Scientists reported that a severe solar storm could trigger rare auroral displays observable in higher latitude regions of northern India on June 8.

science.title: Male Infertility Costs Nearly As Much As Endometriosis Treatment In India: Study
science.summary: A clinical study published on healthcare costs highlighted that managing male infertility in India now incurs expenses comparable to major reproductive conditions like endometriosis.

science.title: Dr Shyam Sundar Nandi Honoured with Phoenix Award at Health AI Con 2026
science.summary: Dr. Shyam Sundar Nandi received the Phoenix Award at the Health AI Con 2026 for leading achievements in expanding artificial intelligence solutions in Indian healthcare.

environment.title: India’s Green Transformation: 12 Years of Sustainability Milestones
environment.summary: Government reviews highlighted a series of national sustainable development milestones and green transformation programs accomplished over the last 12 years.

environment.title: The Teesta at a Crossroads: Communities Caught Between Climate Stress and Geopolitical Tensions
environment.summary: Environmental reports highlighted growing climate vulnerability for riverside populations along the Teesta basin amid ongoing bilateral discussions between India and Bangladesh.

sports.title: Good news for Indian fans: Earlier start times for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's likely debut series
sports.summary: Broadcasters announced revised, earlier start timings for the upcoming international series expected to mark the debut of young Indian cricket talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.

awards_honours.title: Gallantry awards: President Murmu honours 51 winners; Gaganyaan astronaut among Kirti Chakra recipients
awards_honours.summary: President Droupadi Murmu conferred gallantry awards on 51 defense and security personnel, including a Kirti Chakra awarded to a designated Gaganyaan astronaut.

awards_honours.title: Perumal Murugan urges Tamil Nadu govt to institute state-level Sahitya Akademi award
awards_honours.summary: Acclaimed writer Perumal Murugan appealed to the Tamil Nadu state government to establish a dedicated state-level Sahitya Akademi award for Tamil literature.

defence.title: India, world's 5th-largest military spender, dwarfs Pakistan with $92 bn defence spend: SIPRI
defence.summary: The Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) reported that India is the world's 5th-largest military spender with an annual defense allocation of $92 billion and an estimated arsenal of 190 nuclear warheads.

defence.title: Lucknow playing key role in national security through BrahMos Project: Rajnath
defence.summary: Defense Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized the strategic role of the manufacturing unit in Lucknow for strengthening national defense via the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile project.

defence.title: India Fast-Tracks Rampage Supersonic Missile Production
defence.summary: India accelerated domestic manufacturing of the Rampage supersonic precision-strike missile following strategic evaluation in South Asia.

schemes_appointments.title: Union Minister Goyal launches BHAVYA Portal to accelerate development of 100 industrial parks
schemes_appointments.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal launched the BHAVYA portal to oversee and expedite the execution of 100 new industrial park projects across India.

schemes_appointments.title: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana achieves nationwide coverage with West Bengal joining scheme
schemes_appointments.summary: The flagship health coverage initiative Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY achieved pan-India implementation after West Bengal officially signed on to implement the scheme.

schemes_appointments.title: Anupam Misra appointed CMD of Hindustan Copper from July 1
schemes_appointments.summary: The Central Government approved the appointment of Anupam Misra as the new Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of public sector enterprise Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL), effective July 1, 2026.

schemes_appointments.title: Govt Launches 2 Major Schemes To Boost Road Accident Rescue Efforts
schemes_appointments.summary: The Ministry launched two major national schemes intended to enhance emergency assistance and streamline rescue services for road accident victims.

important_days.title: World Oceans Day 8 June - Welcome to the United Nations
important_days.summary: World Oceans Day is commemorated on June 8 to emphasize international efforts toward ocean conservation, marine ecosystem preservation, and sustainable management.

mcqs.q: According to the SIPRI report released in June 2026, what is India's rank among the world's largest military spenders?
mcqs.explanation: As per the latest Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) findings, India is the world's 5th-largest military spender with a total defense budget of $92 billion.

mcqs.q: According to RBI data released for Q4 FY26, what was India's current account balance?
mcqs.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India reported that India achieved a current account surplus of $7.1 billion in the fourth quarter (Q4) of FY26.

mcqs.q: Which digital portal was launched by Union Minister Piyush Goyal to accelerate the development of 100 industrial parks?
mcqs.explanation: Union Minister Piyush Goyal launched the BHAVYA portal specifically to accelerate and monitor the development of 100 industrial parks across India.

mcqs.q: World Oceans Day is observed globally every year on which date?
mcqs.explanation: World Oceans Day is officially designated by the United Nations and celebrated worldwide on June 8.

mcqs.q: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) with effect from July 1, 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Central Government approved the appointment of Anupam Misra as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) starting July 1, 2026.
